provenance.method: Current Acas reasonable-adjustments guidance reviewed for a narrow Great Britain guidance claim.

title: Reasonable adjustments at work
citation: Acas, Reasonable adjustments at work, updated 30 January 2025.

contributions.finding: Acas guidance for Great Britain describes employers considering reasonable adjustments for disabled workers and job applicants and explains that what is reasonable depends on the circumstances.
contributions.population_or_context: Workers, job applicants and employers in England, Scotland and Wales using Acas employment guidance.
contributions.methodology: Authoritative workplace-relations guidance rather than personalised legal advice or an effectiveness study.

limitations.text: Whether an adjustment is legally required or reasonable in an individual case depends on facts and applicable law; Northern Ireland uses a separate employment-relations system.
limitations.why_it_matters: General guidance cannot determine an individual legal dispute or adjustment duty.
reopening_or_reduction_conditions: Recheck if Acas updates the guidance or relevant Great Britain law materially changes.
